Name: Cooler Tools Recolors
Author: lunightmare
Description:
[size=6][center][b][i]~ Cooler Tools ~[/i][/b]
[/center]
[/size][size=4]Yup, I did copper purple because why not?
[/size]
Sooo I wanted to take a little break from modding due to some things that have been going on my life, I need a little rest.
But I had this mod started so, just finished it and publishing it!

This mod changes all the farming tools in the game, except for the scythe since it's considered a weapon.
The watering cans are not recolored, only the default and the iridium one, I'll probably change that later in an update.
Look through the pictures to take a look at what the mod does!
It also changes the finshing poles, making them a bit brighter and making the bamboo one blue.

Honestly, fell in love with how the iridium ones look, I really hope you love it too!!

As you can see in the last pic, it also recolours the Return Scepter, I needed to do that ;)

[u]I'm open to any suggestions!![/u]


[size=5][i][b][center]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS
[/center][/b]

[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]
